#### Components

# Button

The `pui-btn` class turns a `<button>` into a button.

<!-- site: changed: "1.0" -->

```html live
<button class="pui-btn pui-solid pui-theme">Save</button>
```

### Styles

```html live name=basic
<button class="pui-btn pui-soft pui-theme">Soft</button>
```

```html
<!-- a fragment, shown as code only -->
<span class="pui-btn">
```

#### In a group

> [!NOTE]
> Group buttons with `pui-group-row`.
> See [Card](https://github.com/chrissgon/perfectui/blob/main/docs/card.md).

```css
.pui-btn { color: red; }
```
